findings.label: Bare headline-initial 'Peso …' depends on the LLM
findings.detail: 'Peso gana por alza del petróleo' with LLM energy still resolves to energy: no FX_KEYWORDS phrase matches, and headlineNamesCurrency only applies when the LLM already said fx. REGLA DE FX makes LLM fx likely, so this is residual risk, not a regression.
findings.action: Optional: treat a normalized headline starting with 'peso ' as an FX keyword, and add a test with LLM energy.

findings.label: Year filter drops real 4-digit levels
findings.detail: /^(?:19|20)\d{2}$/ also drops price levels such as 'Oro toca 2045 dólares'. Fail-safe: the chart shows no number rather than an invented one.
findings.action: Optional: skip 19xx/20xx only in date context (after 'de'/'en el'/a month) or when no unit follows.
